filename: Martin Ellerby - Elegy for Checkpoint Charlie.md
title: Elegy for Checkpoint Charlie
identity: Martin Ellerby, Elegy for 'Checkpoint Charlie' (2003), for E-flat alto saxophone and junior concert band, with a piano-accompaniment edition. The composer says the solo part was designed at ABRSM Grade 5 level to play with a typical school wind ensemble around Grade 2+; the piano version retains the main contours. Wind Music catalogues the 2005 Studio Music alto/piano score separately from a 2012 concert-band recording.

evidence.claim: Composer lists the 2003 solo E-flat alto saxophone and junior concert band version, plus piano accompaniment; the note describes the intended contrast between an ABRSM Grade 5 solo part and a typical school band around Grade 2+, and calls piano a familiarization/accompaniment alternative.
Wind Music archive lists the E-flat alto saxophone and piano score as Studio Music, London, 2005, four pages; the archive assigns its own Year 4/5 repertoire index.
Separate archive record lists a concert-band recording from 2012 conducted by Mark Heron, 3:16. Audio was not auditioned.

review_focus: Inference from the composer’s stated scoring purpose: compare the piano edition with the band version to identify which accompaniment cues and contours are retained, then consider whether the Grade 5 solo line remains suitable when isolated with piano. The composer’s grade labels describe the intended school-band pairing, not SaxoBrain college years.
collection_flag: Original solo alto saxophone work with junior-band and piano-accompaniment versions; composer describes school wind-band use.
